So, many of the questions were raised through scrutiny—and I was a member of the committee that undertook that scrutiny work—of the previous Government. Work is ongoing, and is being led by the First Minister, in terms of a new international strategy, which is looking at all of the offices, and looking at how we as a Government engage internationally too. He's been very clear that he wants us to be a Government that engages on the international stage because of the benefits to Wales of doing so. As the work on the strategy is updated, of course, there will be opportunities for Members to be questioning the First Minister and to be engaging and scrutinising.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Can I call for two statements today, please? Can I have a statement in relation to the noise assessment work that needs to be done on the A55 in the Llanddulas area from the Deputy Minister for Transport? This is a priority area for noise reduction. Residents in that community have lived with lots of noise from the A55 for many years. We've been told that a noise assessment is going to be done, but there's no indication as to the timeline for that work or when any follow-up work might be completed, in terms of capital investment for noise barriers. So, I think it is something that I would like an update from the Minister on.

Secondly, can I call for a statement from the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care in relation to medical speciality training for next year? I've been contacted by a group of doctors who are internationally trained, who have many years of experience in the Welsh NHS and want to go on to further their careers, but their experience in the NHS is not currently recognised within the framework as giving them priority access to that training. I do think this is something that the Welsh Government could take action on to address some of the gaps in our workforce in the NHS, and I'd be grateful for a statement.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
A gaf i alw am ddau ddatganiad heddiw, os gwelwch chi'n dda? A gaf i ddatganiad gan y Dirprwy Weinidog dros Drafnidiaeth o ran y gwaith angenrheidiol i asesu sŵn traffig ar yr A55 yn ardal Llanddulas? Mae honno'n ardal lle mae lleihau sŵn yn flaenoriaeth. Mae trigolion yn y gymuned honno wedi byw ers blynyddoedd gyda llawer iawn o sŵn oherwydd yr A55. Fe ddywedwyd wrthym ni y byddai asesiad sŵn yn digwydd, ond ni chafwyd unrhyw arwydd ynghylch yr amserlen ar gyfer y gwaith hwnnw nac o ran pa bryd y gellid cwblhau unrhyw waith dilynol, o ran buddsoddiad cyfalaf ar gyfer rhwystrau sŵn. Felly, rwy'n credu y byddai hyn yn rhywbeth yr hoffwn ni gael diweddariad gan y Gweinidog yn ei gylch.

Yn ail, a gaf i alw am ddatganiad gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal o ran hyfforddiant arbenigedd meddygol ar gyfer y flwyddyn nesaf? Mae grŵp o feddygon wedi cysylltu â mi a gafodd eu hyfforddi yn rhyngwladol, sydd â blynyddoedd lawer o brofiad yn y GIG yng Nghymru ac sy'n dymuno mynd ymlaen i ddatblygu eu gyrfaoedd, ond nid yw eu profiad yn y GIG yn cael ei gydnabod yn y fframwaith ar hyn o bryd yn ddigonol i roi'r flaenoriaeth iddyn nhw i gael yr hyfforddiant hwnnw. Rwy'n credu bod hyn yn rhywbeth y gallai Llywodraeth Cymru gymryd camau arno i fynd i'r afael â rhai o'r bylchau yn y gweithlu yn y GIG yma, ac fe fyddwn i'n ddiolchgar am gael datganiad.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch. Mae'r Dirprwy Weinidog dros Drafnidiaeth yma yn y Siambr. Yr hyn byddwn i'n gofyn i chi ei wneud o ran yr A55 ydy ysgrifennu ato fo, a dwi'n siŵr bydd diweddariad i chi o ran hynny.

O ran yr ail ddatganiad rydych chi'n gofyn amdano fo, mi wnaf i godi hyn efo'r Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal. Gan eich bod chi wedi cwrdd yn benodol gydag aelodau'r gweithlu, dwi yn meddwl byddai fo'n syniad pe byddech chi'n gallu ysgrifennu ato fo hefyd, oherwydd mae'n bwysig eu bod nhw'n cael yr ymateb hwnnw. Dwi'n deall, o'r hyn rydych chi'n ei ddweud, eich bod chi wedi ysgrifennu, felly mi fyddaf i yn gofyn iddo fo sicrhau ei fod o yn ysgrifennu nôl atoch chi.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Thank you. The Deputy Minister for Transport is here in the Chamber. What I would ask you to do in terms of the A55 is to write to him, and I'm sure that there will be an update for you on that.

In terms of the second statement that you request, I will raise this with the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care. Since you have met specifically with members of the workforce, then I think it would be a good idea for you to write to him as well, because it is important that they get that response. I understand, from what you say, that you have written, so I will ask him to ensure that he writes back to you.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Gaf i ofyn am ddatganiad gan y Dirprwy Weinidog dros Drafnidiaeth ar gynlluniau Network Rail i gau'r rheilffordd rhwng Caergybi a Chaer am bedair wythnos ym mis Ionawr er mwyn cynnal gwaith atgyweirio ar hyd y llinell? Mae hwn yn rheilffordd y mae miloedd o bobl yn ddibynnol arno, ac felly bydd yr effaith y bydd hyn yn ei chael ar deithwyr ym Mangor Conwy Môn a gogledd Cymru yn sylweddol. Serch hynny, mae nifer fawr o bobl sy'n defnyddio'r gwasanaethau yma yn rheolaidd yn parhau yn anymwybodol o'r tarfu sydd o'u blaenau. Dwi'n falch o weld bod Network Rail erbyn hyn wedi cyhoeddi rhagor o ddeunydd gwybodaeth am y gwaith, ond hoffwn ofyn am ddatganiad gan y Dirprwy Weinidog sy'n gosod allan y gefnogaeth y gall Llywodraeth Cymru ei rhoi rhwng rŵan a mis Ionawr i ledaenu'r gair, fel bod trigolion lleol yn ymwybodol o'r sefyllfa ac yn cael cyfle i baratoi cynlluniau teithio amgen. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Can I ask for a statement from the Deputy Minister for Transport on Network Rail's plans to close the railway between Holyhead and Chester for four weeks in January to carry out repair works along the line? This is a line that thousands of people rely on, and therefore the impact that this will have on passengers in Bangor Conwy Môn and north Wales will be significant. However, many people who use these services regularly remain unaware of the disruption that lies ahead. I'm pleased to see that Network Rail has now published further information about the work, but I would like to request a statement from the Deputy Minister outlining the support that the Welsh Government can provide between now and January to spread the word, ensuring that local residents are aware of the situation and have the opportunity to make alternative travel arrangements. Thank you.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi'r mater hwn. Rwy'n gwerthfawrogi y bydd hyn yn creu aflonyddwch o ran y gwasanaeth dros dro i deithwyr tra bydd y rheilffordd ar gau. Mae'r Dirprwy Weinidog dros Drafnidiaeth eisoes wedi cyhoeddi datganiad ysgrifenedig. Os oes yna unrhyw bryderon ychwanegol, mi fyddwn i'n eich annog chi i ysgrifennu at yr Aelod. Mae o yma, wrth gwrs, ac wedi clywed yr hyn rydych chi wedi'i godi. Ond, i'ch sicrhau chi, mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn ymgysylltu gyda Network Rail ac Avanti a Trafnidiaeth Cymru trwy gyfarfodydd rhwydwaith gogledd Cymru, ac mae Trafnidiaeth Cymru ac Avanti yn cwblhau cynlluniau manwl ar gyfer gwasanaethau bysiau yn lle trenau yn ystod y cyfnod cau hefyd.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising this issue. I appreciate that this will cause temporary disruption in terms of the service for travellers while the railway is closed. The Deputy Minister for Transport has already published a written statement. If there are any additional concerns, then I would encourage you to write to the Member. He is here, of course, and he will have heard what you've raised. But, just to reassure you, the Welsh Government is engaging with Network Rail and Avanti and Transport for Wales through network north Wales meetings, and Transport for Wales and Avanti are completing detailed plans for bus replacement services during that closure period as well.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Business Manager, can I ask for a joint statement from the Deputy Minister for social care, the Minister for local government and the Minister for education on the pupil development grant for children looked after? The issue I raise is complicated and cuts across multiple portfolios. A recent Estyn report highlighted concerns about the current PDG-CLA funding arrangements. Corporate parenting responsibility remains with the placing authority, but the receiving authorities are required to provide support from their own PDG-CLA allocation. Estyn also reported existing arrangements did not always operate effectively, including inconsistent information sharing and joint working, particularly when learners move between settings, services and local authorities. So, can I have a statement on how the Welsh Government intends to address these issues highlighted in Estyn's report? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Reolwr Busnes, a gaf i ofyn am ddatganiad ar y cyd gan y Dirprwy Weinidog dros ofal cymdeithasol, y Gweinidog dros lywodraeth leol a'r Gweinidog dros addysg ar y grant datblygu disgyblion i blant sy'n derbyn gofal? Mae'r mater yr wyf i'n ei godi yn un  cymhleth ac yn torri ar draws nifer o bortffolios. Roedd adroddiad diweddar gan Estyn yn tynnu sylw at bryderon am y trefniadau cyllido grant datblygu disgyblion ar gyfer plant sy’n derbyn gofal presennol. Mae cyfrifoldeb rhianta corfforaethol yn dal i aros gyda'r awdurdod lleoli, ond mae hi'n ofynnol i'r awdurdodau sy'n derbyn ddarparu cymorth o'u dyraniad grant datblygu disgyblion ar gyfer plant sy’n derbyn gofal eu hunain. Roedd Estyn yn adrodd hefyd nad oedd y trefniadau presennol yn gweithredu yn effeithiol bob amser, ac yn cynnwys anghysondebau o ran rhannu gwybodaeth a chydweithio, yn enwedig pan fydd dysgwyr yn symud rhwng lleoliadau, gwasanaethau ac awdurdodau lleol. Felly, a gaf i ddatganiad ar sut mae Llywodraeth Cymru yn bwriadu mynd i'r afael â'r materion hyn sydd wedi dod i'r amlwg yn adroddiad Estyn? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn hwnnw. O ran y datganiad, dydy o ddim yn arferol i gael datganiad ar y cyd yn y modd hwnnw. Mi ydyn ni'n gweithio'n drawslywodraethol ac, yn sicr, pe byddech chi'n ysgrifennu at y Gweinidogion efo'ch cwestiynau penodol, mi fyddech chi'n cael yr ymateb hwnnw. Ond, yn amlwg, y Gweinidog Cabinet dros addysg sy'n arwain o ran y pupil development grant, ond mae cydweithio agos rhwng Gweinidogion lle mae gorgyffwrdd. Yr hyn sy'n bwysig ydy ein bod ni'n cael y cydweithio hwnnw ac mai'r hyn rydyn ni'n ceisio ei gyflawni ydy ymateb bob tro i argymhellion Estyn. Mae yna waith, wrth gwrs, i'r pwyllgorau craffu priodol yn y Senedd hon a grŵp trawsbleidiol i fod yn edrych ar faterion o'r fath, a sicrhau bod y gweithrediad fel y dylai fod a bod argymhellion sy'n cael eu gwneud gan Estyn yn mynd rhagddynt.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for that question. In terms of a statement, it's not the norm to have a joint statement in that way. We do work across Government, of course, and certainly, if you were to write to the Ministers with specific questions, then you would receive that response. But, clearly, the Cabinet Minister for education leads on the pupil development grant, but there is close collaboration between Ministers where there is that overlap. What is important is that we do have that co-operation, because what we're trying to do is to always respond to Estyn recommendations. There is work, of course, for the relevant scrutiny committees in this Senedd and the cross-party group to be looking at such issues, to ensure that implementation is as it should be and that recommendations made by Estyn are progressed.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Prynhawn da, Drefnydd. I want a statement, please, on the services for women, in particular in rural areas, when they face domestic violence. Last week, two cases in Wales were in our media. In Carmarthen, James McKenna was jailed for 24 years for the attempted murder of his ex-partner, whom he stalked and stabbed repeatedly as she walked her dog. And secondly, there's the really tragic case in Prestatyn, of mother of four Samantha Phythian, who was pregnant and found dead in a burning van. All of these cases, along with the cases of women who are living in rural areas that I represent, show how hard it is for those women to get the services and the responses they need. Could you please give us an update and a statement, and perhaps from the Minister as well, on services for women who face domestic violence and what you're doing to develop these and ensure that they reach everybody? Diolch yn fawr iawn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Prynhawn da, Drefnydd. Fe hoffwn i gael datganiad, os gwelwch chi'n dda, ar y gwasanaethau i fenywod, yn enwedig mewn ardaloedd gwledig, wrth iddyn nhw wynebu trais domestig. Yr wythnos diwethaf, roedd sôn yn y cyfryngau am ddau achos yng Nghymru. Yng Nghaerfyrddin, fe gafodd James McKenna ei garcharu am 24 mlynedd am geisio llofruddio ei gyn-bartner, y gwnaeth ei stelcio a'i thrywanu droeon wrth iddi fynd â'r ci am dro. Ac yn ail, roedd yna achos trist iawn ym Mhrestatyn, pan gafodd Samantha Phythian, mam i bedwar o blant, ac a oedd yn feichiog, ei darganfod yn gelain mewn fan a oedd ar dân. Mae'r achosion hyn i gyd, ynghyd ag achosion menywod sy'n byw mewn ardaloedd yng nghefn gwlad yr wyf i'n eu cynrychioli, yn dangos pa mor anodd yw hi i'r menywod hynny gael gafael ar y gwasanaethau a'r ymatebiadau y mae eu hangen arnyn nhw. A wnewch chi roi diweddariad a datganiad i ni, ac efallai gan y Gweinidog hefyd, ar wasanaethau i fenywod sy'n wynebu trais domestig a'r hyn yr ydych chi'n ei wneud i ddatblygu'r pethau hyn a sicrhau bod pawb yn gallu cael gafael arnyn nhw? Diolch yn fawr iawn.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi mater, yn amlwg, a gafodd gryn sylw yn y wasg yr wythnos diwethaf, a byddwn i'n hoffi dweud pa mor ddewr ydy pobl sydd yn siarad allan am hyn, ac mae'n erchyll clywed am y dioddefaint hwnnw. Mae'r Dirprwy Brif Weinidog yma ac wedi clywed yr hyn rydych chi wedi ei godi, ond mi fyddwn ni'n hoffi rhoi'r sicrwydd hwnna i chi ein bod ni'n cydnabod hyn, bod yr adolygiad diweddar o'r strategaeth genedlaethol o ran VAWDASV wedi nodi anghydraddoldeb gwledig fel thema allweddol o ran y gwaith hwn. Rŵan, wrth i'r strategaeth genedlaethol newydd gael ei datblygu, dwi'n gobeithio bod y ffaith ein bod ni wedi adnabod hwn fel rhywbeth sydd ei angen ac sy'n haeddu sylw pellach—. Ac wrth gwrs, wrth i'r gwaith adolygu yna fynd rhagddo, gyda'r adborth rydyn ni wedi ei dderbyn, mi fydd yna gyfle i chi ac eraill graffu ar y Dirprwy Brif Weinidog o ran y gwaith hwnnw ac i fewnbynnu.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising this issue, which received a lot of attention in the press last week, and I would like to say how brave those people who are speaking out about these things are, and it is terrible to hear about that suffering. The Deputy First Minister is here and will have heard what you've raised, and I would like to give you that assurance that we do acknowledge this, that the recent review of the national VAWDASV strategy has noted rural inequality as a key theme in terms of this work. Now, as the new national strategy is developed, I hope that the fact that we have identified this as something that is needed and deserves further attention—. As that review work continues, along with the feedback received, you will have an opportunity, as will others, to scrutinise the Deputy First Minister in relation to that work and to input as well.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, I would like a statement from the Government regarding the threat to our most valuable industry, tourism. In Carmarthenshire, tourism earned, in 2024-25, £724 million, employing over 6,600 full-time employees. This is vital to Wales's economy, and we need to listen to the challenge it is facing. I believe this Government doesn't appear to be listening. A whole raft of taxation and regulation is having a serious impact on these businesses. Let's talk about the visitor levy, a tourist tax that is placing another burden on the industry. We are now faced with plans to turn Wales into a giant energy park, with hundreds of enormous wind turbines and pylons in our most beautiful countryside that attracts millions of visitors. Are you aware of the impact? Are you listening to the tourism industry? And what action are you taking to protect it? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, fe hoffwn i gael datganiad gan y Llywodraeth ynglŷn â'r bygythiad i'n diwydiant mwyaf gwerthfawr, sef twristiaeth. Yn sir Gaerfyrddin, cyfrannodd twristiaeth £724 miliwn yn 2024-25, gan gyflogi dros 6,600 o weithwyr amser llawn. Mae hyn yn hanfodol i economi Cymru, ac mae angen i ni wrando ar yr her mae'r diwydiant yn ei hwynebu. Rwyf i o'r farn nad yw'r Llywodraeth hon yn gwrando, i bob golwg. Mae lliaws o drethiant a rheoleiddio yn cael effaith ddifrifol ar y busnesau hyn. Gadewch i ni siarad am yr ardoll ymwelwyr, treth ar dwristiaeth sy'n rhoi baich arall ar y diwydiant. Rydym ni'n wynebu cynlluniau i droi Cymru yn barc ynni enfawr erbyn hyn, gyda channoedd o dyrbinau gwynt a pheilonau enfawr yn y wlad harddaf sydd gennym ac sy'n denu miliynau o ymwelwyr. A ydych chi'n ymwybodol o'r effaith? A ydych chi'n gwrando ar y diwydiant twristiaeth? A pha gamau ydych chi'n eu cymryd i'w amddiffyn? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Wel, mae twristiaeth yn bwysig ofnadwy o ran economi Cymru, ac mi fydd yr Aelod, dwi'n siŵr, yn gwybod bod yna nifer fawr o heriau sydd wedi wynebu'r sector hwnnw, gan gynnwys yr argyfwng costau byw. Mae gan bobl lai o arian yn eu pocedi. Mae Brexit hefyd, er enghraifft, wedi cael effaith ar nifer y bobl sy'n dod i Gymru a'n cymunedau ni. Rydych chi'n cyfeirio at ardal sydd ddim yn mynd rhagddo efo'r lefi twristiaeth ar y funud, gan nodi hwnna fel rhwystr, a dwi ddim yn deall hynny. Mae'n rhaid i ni edrych ar y ffeithiau. Mi fydd pob ardal efo'i heriau gwahanol. Rydyn ni hefyd yn gwybod bod yna gyfleon yn dod efo rhai o'r pethau sydd mewn grym. Ond yr hyn rydyn ni wedi ymrwymo iddo fo ydy sicrhau ein bod ni'n gweithio gyda Chroeso Cymru i werthu Cymru i'r byd, ein bod ni eisiau sicrhau bod twristiaeth yn gallu ffynnu a'n bod ni'n cefnogi'r busnesau hynny. Mae o'n ganolog o ran yr hyn rydyn ni wedi ei roi yn ein maniffesto ni a'r gwaith rydyn ni'n edrych yn drawsweinidigol arno fo. Dwi, fel Gweinidog efo cyfrifoldeb dros ddiwylliant a chwaraeon, hefyd yn credu nad ydyn ni'n manteisio i'r eithaf o ran y dwristiaeth sy'n gysylltiedig efo'n hanes ni, efo'n diwylliant ni, a'r cyfleoedd sydd yn dod efo digwyddiadau mawr, fel y Tour de France, fel yr Ewros yn dod yn 2028. Felly, mae twristiaeth yn bwysig iawn i'r Llywodraeth hon ac rydyn ni'n gweithio'n drawsweinidogol ar hynny.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Well, tourism is hugely important for the Welsh economy, and the Member, I'm sure, will be aware that there are a number of challenges that have been faced by that sector, including the cost-of-living crisis. People have less money in their pockets. There is also the impact of Brexit, which has had an impact on the number of visitors to Wales and to our communities. You're referring to an area that is not implementing the tourism levy at the moment and referring to that as a barrier, and I don't really understand that. We have to look at the facts as they are. Every area will have its own challenges. We also know that there are opportunities that come with some of the things that are in train. But what we are committed to is ensuring that we work with Visit Wales to sell Wales to the world, that we want to ensure that tourism can prosper and that we support those businesses. It is central as regards what was in our manifesto and to the work that we are looking at on a cross-ministerial basis. As a Government, I, as Minister with responsibility for culture and sport, also believe that we're not taking full advantage of the tourism related to our history, our culture, and the opportunities that comes with major events such as the Tour de France and the Euros in 2028. Therefore, tourism is hugely important to this Government and we are working on a cross-ministerial basis on it.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, I'd like to request a statement on transport accessibility for blind and partially sighted people from the Deputy Minister for Transport to understand what more can be done to ensure everyone can travel safely, confidently and independently. Last week, I had the privilege of spending the morning with Rachel from the Royal National Institute of Blind People and her guide dog, Flick, as we attempted to walk from the bus station in Wrexham to the train station. I was provided a pair of goggles to help me understand Rachel's visual impairment. What struck me was the daily challenges facing people with sight loss in navigating their surroundings and accessing public transport. Access to public transport is essential for people to maintain their independence, access healthcare and stay connected to their communities. It's important that buses, trains and transport infrastructure are accessible, and that people with sight loss feel safe when travelling, certainly to avoid any risk of isolation. So, I'd be grateful for a statement from the Deputy Minister to highlight the work undertaken by the Welsh Government to ensure that blind and partially sighted people can access this transport as easily as possible. Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, fe hoffwn i ofyn am ddatganiad ar hygyrchedd trafnidiaeth i bobl ddall a phobl sy'n gweld yn rhannol gan y Dirprwy Weinidog dros Drafnidiaeth i gael deall yr hyn y gellir ei wneud eto i sicrhau bod pawb yn gallu teithio yn ddiogel, yn hyderus ac yn annibynnol. Yr wythnos diwethaf, fe gefais i'r fraint o dreulio'r bore gyda Rachel o'r RNIB a Flick, ei chi tywys, wrth i ni geisio cerdded o'r orsaf fysiau yn Wrecsam i'r orsaf drenau. Roeddwn i'n gwisgo goglau i'm helpu i ddeall y nam sydd ar olwg Rachel. Yr hyn oedd yn fy nharo i oedd yr heriau sy'n wynebu pobl sydd wedi colli eu golwg bob dydd wrth iddyn nhw lywio drwy eu hamgylcheddau a defnyddio trafnidiaeth gyhoeddus. Mae gallu defnyddio trafnidiaeth gyhoeddus yn hanfodol er mwyn i bobl aros yn annibynnol, i gael mynediad at ofal iechyd a chadw mewn cysylltiad â'u cymunedau. Mae hi'n bwysig bod bysiau, trenau a seilwaith trafnidiaeth yn hygyrch, a bod pobl sy'n colli eu golwg yn teimlo yn ddiogel wrth deithio, yn sicr i osgoi unrhyw berygl o'u hynysu. Felly, fe fyddwn i'n ddiolchgar am ddatganiad gan y Dirprwy Weinidog i dynnu sylw at y gwaith sydd wedi cael ei wneud gan Lywodraeth Cymru i sicrhau bod pobl ddall a phobl sy'n gweld yn rhannol yn gallu defnyddio trafnidiaeth gyhoeddus mor rhwydd â phosibl. Diolch i chi.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch. Mae'r Aelod yn berffaith iawn, mae hwn yn fater pwysig dros ben. Dwi'n siŵr bod pob un ohonon ni wedi cael etholwyr yn cysylltu efo pryderon neu sy'n methu â defnyddio trafnidiaeth gyhoeddus ar y funud oherwydd nad ydyn nhw'n teimlo'n ddiogel ac nad ydyn nhw'n gallu cael y gwasanaethau sydd yn gweddu iddyn nhw. Yn sicr, mae'r Dirprwy Weinidog dros Drafnidiaeth yma ac wedi clywed yr hyn rydych chi wedi ei godi, ac wedi mynegi i fi ei fod o'n fodlon dod â diweddariad i Aelodau drwy ddatganiad ysgrifenedig.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you. The Member is quite right, this is a very important issue. I'm sure that all of us have had constituents getting in touch with concerns or who haven't been able to use public transport because they don't feel safe and don't feel that they can access services that are appropriate for them. Certainly, the Deputy Minister for Transport is present and has heard what you've raised, and he has expressed to me that he's willing to bring an update to Members through a written statement.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Trefnydd, I would like to request an urgent Government statement on the independence, accountability and powers of Care Inspectorate Wales. When social services fail, accountability cannot be optional. Section 150 of Social Services and Well-being (Wales) Act 2014 sets out clear statutory grounds for intervention where a local authority fails, or is likely to fail, in the exercise of its social services functions. Section 152 then gives Welsh Ministers the power to intervene where statutory conditions aren't met. Yet, Care Inspectorate Wales exercises its functions on behalf of Welsh Ministers. That raises a serious question about whether professional independence goes far enough. Families affected by serious failures deserve a regulator whose structural independence is beyond question, with powers necessary to expose systematic problems and ensure they are acted upon. Will the Government, therefore, bring forward an urgent statement setting out precisely how it will ensure that Care Inspectorate Wales can make decisions independently of Welsh Ministers, while remaining fully transparent and accountable to the people of Wales and the Senedd? Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Drefnydd, fe hoffwn i ofyn am ddatganiad brys gan y Llywodraeth ar annibyniaeth, atebolrwydd a phwerau Arolygiaeth Gofal Cymru. Pan fydd gwasanaethau cymdeithasol yn pallu, ni all atebolrwydd fod yn ddewisol. Mae adran 150 o Ddeddf Gwasanaethau Cymdeithasol a Llesiant (Cymru) 2014 yn nodi seiliau statudol pendant dros ymyrryd pan fo awdurdod lleol yn pallu, neu'n debygol o ballu, wrth ymarfer ei swyddogaethau o ran gwasanaethau cymdeithasol. Yna mae adran 152 yn rhoi'r pŵer i Weinidogion Cymru ymyrryd lle nad yw amodau statudol yn cael eu bodloni. Ac eto, ar ran Gweinidogion Cymru y mae Arolygiaeth Gofal Cymru yn ymarfer ei swyddogaethau. Mae hynny'n codi cwestiwn difrifol ynghylch pa mor bell y mae annibyniaeth broffesiynol yn mynd. Mae teuluoedd yr effeithir arnyn nhw gan fethiannau difrifol yn haeddu rheoleiddiwr y mae ei annibyniaeth strwythurol y tu hwnt i unrhyw amheuaeth, gyda phwerau angenrheidiol i ddatgelu problemau cyfundrefnol a sicrhau eu bod nhw'n cael eu rhoi ar waith. A wnaiff y Llywodraeth, felly, gyflwyno datganiad brys yn nodi yn union sut y bydd hi'n sicrhau y gall Arolygiaeth Gofal Cymru wneud penderfyniadau yn annibynnol ar Weinidogion Cymru, wrth barhau i fod yn gwbl dryloyw ac yn atebol i bobl Cymru a'r Senedd? Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi'r pryderon hynny. Dwi ddim yn gwybod os ydych chi wedi ysgrifennu at y Gweinidog Cabinet gyda'r pryderon penodol—yn amlwg, mewn munud, mae'n anodd i chi roi'r holl wybodaeth hynny. Ond, yn sicr, os oes yna bryderon y mae angen i ni eu hystyried, wrth gwrs y gwnawn ni hynny fel Llywodraeth. Felly, byddwn ni yn gofyn i chi wneud hynny.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising those concerns. I don't know if you have written to the Cabinet Minister expressing those concerns—it's difficult for you to provide all of those details when you only have a minute to speak. But if there are concerns that we need to take into account, then of course we as a Government will do that. So, I would ask you to write to the Minister.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Business Minister, can I please request an urgent statement from the Welsh Government about the proposed closure of the three junctions alongside the M4 in Newport? All residents know that shutting down junctions 27, 26 and 25 on the M4 would be disastrous and cause nothing but chaos and mayhem across the city, with traffic being pushed into already congested routes. Now, news of the Government's junction closure plans has sparked anger and uproar in Newport, with constituents inundating me and other MSs with e-mails, calls and also letters. The message is clear: they want the Government to keep their hands off our motorway junctions. And I've spoken to numerous constituents living near junction 27 who've told me that they're seriously considering moving and selling up because they just can't handle what's going to be coming their way. And it's not just residents and businesses who have serious concerns over the Government plans. Gwent police and crime commissioner has warned that these closures could pose a serious risk to our emergency service response times, going forward. The Government has insisted that it will listen to the concerns and voice of those directly impacted by these plans, but we haven't heard how exactly this is going to be achieved. So, an urgent statement from the Government outlining its plans, how it's going to be consulting with residents, businesses and emergency services, as well as others, and when this work will start, is urgently needed by us all. Thank you.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Weinidog dros fusnes, a gaf i ofyn am ddatganiad brys gan Lywodraeth Cymru ynglŷn â'r bwriad i gau'r tair cyffordd wrth ymyl yr M4 yng Nghasnewydd? Mae'r trigolion i gyd yn gwybod y byddai cau cyffyrdd 27, 26 a 25 ar yr M4 yn drychinebus ac yn achosi dim ond anhrefn a thryblith ar draws y ddinas, gyda thraffig yn cael ei wthio ar lwybrau sydd eisoes yn gweld tagfeydd. Nawr, mae'r newyddion am gynlluniau'r Llywodraeth i gau'r cyffyrdd wedi ennyn dicter a chynnwrf yng Nghasnewydd, gydag etholwyr yn anfon llif mawr o e-byst, galwadau ffôn, a llythyrau at ASau eraill a minnau. Mae'r neges yn amlwg: maen nhw'n awyddus i'r Llywodraeth hon gadw ei bachau oddi ar gyffyrdd ein traffyrdd. Ac rwyf i wedi siarad â nifer o etholwyr sy'n byw ar bwys cyffordd 27 sydd wedi dweud wrthyf i eu bod nhw'n wirioneddol yn ystyried symud i ffwrdd a gwerthu am na fyddan nhw'n gallu byw gyda'r hyn sydd ar ddod. Ac nid yn unig y trigolion a'r busnesau sydd â phryderon difrifol am gynlluniau'r Llywodraeth. Mae comisiynydd heddlu a throseddu Gwent wedi rhybuddio y gallai cau y rhain achosi perygl difrifol o ran amseroedd ymateb ein gwasanaethau brys, yn y dyfodol. Mae'r Llywodraeth wedi mynnu y bydd hi'n gwrando ar y pryderon a lleisiau'r rhai yr effeithir arnynt yn uniongyrchol gan y cynlluniau hyn, ond nid ydym ni wedi cael clywed sut yn union y bydd hynny'n cael ei gyflawni. Felly, mae angen datganiad brys gan y Llywodraeth yn amlinellu ei chynlluniau, sut y bydd hi'n ymgynghori â thrigolion, busnesau a'r gwasanaethau brys, yn ogystal ag eraill, ac yn dweud pa bryd y bydd y gwaith hwn yn dechrau, a hynny ar frys er mwyn pawb ohonom ni. Diolch i chi.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Dwi'n gobeithio bod yr Aelod wedi clywed y datganiad llafar yr wythnos diwethaf. Dwi ddim yn meddwl bod yna ddiffyg cyfle wedi bod i graffu a holi'r Gweinidog. Felly, dwi ddim yn meddwl bod datganiad mor fuan wedi hynny yn briodol, yn arbennig oherwydd, beth am inni gofio, beth oedd yr hyn a nodwyd, sef ein bod ni rŵan yn mynd i fod yn edrych ar ystyried y dystiolaeth, deall y ffeithiau a'r gwahanol opsiynau, a gweithio tuag at ddatrysiadau sy'n gwella teithiau wrth gefnogi cymunedau, busnesau a'r economi ehangach. Felly, o ran yr holl bryderon rydych chi wedi'u nodi, dyna'n union beth fydd yn digwydd rŵan: gwrando.

Dwi'n siŵr hefyd fod yr Aelod—fel pob Aelod yma, gobeithio—eisiau gweld y Llywodraeth hon yn gweithredu. Rydyn ni wedi gweld 27 mlynedd o beidio â gweithredu a chael datrysiadau, felly mae'n rhaid inni symud ymlaen efo'r gwaith hwn. Mae'r gwaith ymgysylltu yn mynd rhagddo. Mae yna gyfle i bawb sydd efo pryderon i fod yn rhan o hyn. Mi gyhoeddwyd yr wythnos diwethaf y bydd yna ragor o ddiweddariadau ac mi fydd yna gyfle i bobl ymgysylltu. Felly, dwi'n gobeithio ein bod ni'n gallu uno yn y ffaith bod y Gweinidog wedi amlinellu ffordd ymlaen o'r diwedd, a bydd yna gyfle i'r rheini sydd efo pryderon i fynegi'r rheini. Ond mae'n rhaid inni weld datrysiad. Dwi'n siŵr bod yr Aelod yn gytûn ar hynny.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
I hope that the Member heard the oral statement last week. I don't think there has been a lack of opportunity to scrutinise and to ask the Minister questions. So, I don't think that a statement so soon after that is appropriate, in particular because, let's bear in mind, of what was noted, which was that we're now going to be looking at considering the evidence, understanding the different facts and options, and working towards solutions that improve journeys whilst supporting communities, businesses and the broader economy. So, as to all of the concerns that you have set out, that's exactly what will be happening now: listening.

I'm sure as well that the Member—like all Members here, I hope—wants to see this Government taking action. We have seen 27 years of a lack of action and a lack of solutions, so we have to move forward with this work. The engagement work is happening at the moment, and everyone with concerns has an opportunity to be part of this. It was announced last week that there would be more updates and opportunities for people to be engaging. So, I hope that we will be able to unite behind the fact that the Minister has outlined a way forward finally, and there will be an opportunity for those who have concerns to express those. But we do have to see a solution. I'm sure the Member agrees with me on that.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Good afternoon, Trefnydd. Since questioning the First Minister on NHS dental care last week, I have had countless constituents and people across Wales get in contact. One said that they have waited unsuccessfully since 2019 to get back on an NHS list, now facing £800-plus for root canal treatment. Another says they finally secured NHS care, only to be restricted to emergency treatment due to the new dental contract. Another says their practice has gone private, demanding £264 a year just for membership fees. This is the reality of your fundamentally flawed dental contract. A new dental school is welcome, of course it is, but it is the contract that needs reworking, and this Government needs to listen, as I said last week, to practising dentists to make the contract fit for purpose. A lack of NHS dental care is now a national emergency, and I believe this requires an urgent statement on the floor of this Senedd or a debate to address this. Diolch.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Prynhawn da, Drefnydd. Ers i mi ofyn cwestiynau i'r Prif Weinidog ar ofal deintyddol y GIG yr wythnos diwethaf, mae nifer o etholwyr a phobl ledled Cymru wedi cysylltu â mi. Roedd un yn dweud ei fod wedi aros ers 2019 i fynd yn ôl ar restr y GIG heb unrhyw lwyddiant ac sy'n wynebu costau o fwy na £800 erbyn hyn am driniaeth i sianel y gwreiddyn. Mae un arall yn dweud ei fod wedi sicrhau gofal gan y GIG o'r diwedd, dim ond i gael hwnnw wedi ei gyfyngu i driniaethau brys oherwydd y contract deintyddol newydd. Roedd rhywun arall yn dweud bod ei bractis wedi mynd yn breifat, gan wneud ffi aelodaeth o £264 y flwyddyn yn ofynnol. Dyma sefyllfa wirioneddol eich contract deintyddol chi sy'n hanfodol ddiffygiol. Mae yna groeso i ysgol ddeintyddol newydd, wrth gwrs, ond y contract sydd angen ei ailwampio, ac mae angen i'r Llywodraeth hon wrando, fel dywedais i'r wythnos diwethaf, ar ddeintyddion sy'n ymarfer i wneud y contract yn addas i'r diben. Mae diffyg gofal deintyddol y GIG yn argyfwng cenedlaethol erbyn hyn, ac rwy'n credu bod angen datganiad brys ar lawr y Senedd hon neu ddadl i fynd i'r afael â hyn. Diolch.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch i'r Aelod am godi'r materion hyn. Byddwch chi wedi clywed ymateb y Prif Weinidog yr wythnos diwethaf, oedd hefyd yn cydnabod pryderon roedd o wedi'u derbyn gan etholwyr—rhai y byddwn ni i gyd wedi'u derbyn. Mi wnaeth y Prif Weinidog hefyd amlinellu'r adolygiad o'r contract hwnnw, sef yr union hyn mae'r Aelod wedi'i godi. Mi fyddwch chi'n ymwybodol bod gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal gwestiynau yr wythnos nesaf. Bydd yna gyfle i'w holi fo ymhellach am hyn, ac yn sicr mi wnaf i o'n ymwybodol eich bod wedi codi'r mater hwn yr wythnos yma.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: I thank the Member for raising these issues. You will have heard the First Minister's response last week, who also recognised the concerns expressed to him by constituents, and I'm sure we will all have received similar comments. The First Minister also outlined the review of the contract, which is exactly the issue the Member raised. You will be aware that the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care has questions next week. So, there will be an opportunity to question him further on this issue then, and I will make him aware that you have raised the issue today.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Yn olaf, Drefnydd, Janet Finch-Saunders.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Finally, Trefnydd, Janet Finch-Saunders.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 2. Datganiad a Chyhoeddiad Busnes
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch, Lywydd. Hoffwn i ofyn am ddatganiad gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal am sut maen nhw'n gweithio i ddileu sgabies yng Nghymru. Dros y mis diwethaf, rydyn ni wedi gweld dau ysbyty yn cau wardiau achos presenoldeb sgabies Norwyaidd. Mae nifer yr achosion o sgabies yng Nghymru wedi cynyddu o 1,300 yn 2018-19 i dros 12,000 o achosion yn 2023-24. Mae hyn yn bryderus iawn ac yn achosi anghysur sylweddol i gleifion ac yn gwneud i bobl feddwl ddwywaith cyn mynd i'r ysbyty. Mae angen cymryd camau brys i ddelio â'r clefyd erchyll hwn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you, Llywydd. I would like to request a statement from the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care on how they are working to eradicate scabies in Wales. Over the last month, we have seen two hospitals close wards due to the presence of Norwegian scabies. The number of cases of scabies in Wales has increased from 1,300 in 2018-19 to over 12,000 cases in 2023-24. This is deeply concerning and is causing patients significant discomfort and making people think twice before going to hospital. Urgent action needs to be taken to eradicate this horrific disease.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 2. Business Statement and Announcement
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Diolch yn fawr iawn i'r Aelod am y cwestiwn, a'i Chymraeg gwych, os caf i ddweud. O ran y mater rydych chi'n ei godi, yn amlwg mae hwn yn bryder. Mi godwyd y mater o sgabies gyda ni yr wythnos diwethaf hefyd. Byddwn ni i gyd wedi gweld yn y wasg hefyd y pryderon hynny. Yn sicr, mi wnes i roi'r sicrwydd yr wythnos diwethaf o ran y camau a'r disgwyliadau sydd gennym ni o fyrddau iechyd, o ran rheoli haint. Yn sicr, mi wnaf i hefyd sicrhau bod y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Iechyd a Gofal yn gwybod bod yna ail gais wedi dod ynglŷn â diweddariad o ran y gwaith hwn. Mi fydd o'n ateb cwestiynau yr wythnos nesaf, ond mi wnaf i weld a ydy o'n meddwl ei fod o'n briodol i roi datganiad ysgrifenedig pellach ar hyn.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated: Thank you very much to the Member for that question, and her wonderful Welsh, if I may say so. In terms of the issue that you raised, clearly this is a concern. And the issue of scabies was raised with me last week too. We will all have seen in the press and media those concerns expressed. I gave an assurance last week in terms of the steps that we are taking and our expectations of health boards in terms of disease control. Certainly, I will also ensure that the Cabinet Minister for Health and Care is aware that a second request has been made for an update on that work. He will be answering questions next week, but I will see whether he thinks it's appropriate that there should be a further written statement on this issue.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a’r Cyfansoddiad: Y camau nesaf ar gyfer Gorchymyn (Dynodi) Parc Cenedlaethol Glyndŵr
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Statement by the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution: The next steps for the Glyndŵr National Park (Designation) Order
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_English: Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Member_job_title_Welsh: Y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a’r Cyfansoddiad
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. Today, I am updating Members on the next steps regarding the Glyndŵr National Park (Designation) Order submitted to Welsh Ministers by Natural Resources Wales in January of this year.

Following careful consideration of the designation Order, the evidence assembled by Natural Resources Wales, the representations and objections received during the designation process, and the associated impact assessments, I have reached a provisional view in respect of the question of whether to confirm, confirm with modifications or to reject the designation Order. I am currently minded not to confirm the designation Order, and consequently minded not to proceed with a public local inquiry at this stage. Not confirming the designation Order and not proceeding with a public local inquiry will mean that no new national park is established at this time.

I do want to be clear with Members that this is not a final decision. Before reaching a final decision, I intend to provide a short opportunity for everyone with an interest in this proposal to make further representations in respect of the provisional view that I have reached.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. Heddiw, rwy'n rhoi'r wybodaeth ddiweddaraf i'r Aelodau am y camau nesaf ynglŷn â Gorchymyn (Dynodi) Parc Cenedlaethol Glyndŵr a gyflwynwyd i Weinidogion Cymru gan Cyfoeth Naturiol Cymru ym mis Ionawr eleni.

Ar ôl ystyried y Gorchymyn dynodi'n ofalus, y dystiolaeth a gasglwyd gan Cyfoeth Naturiol Cymru, y sylwadau a'r gwrthwynebiadau a dderbyniwyd yn ystod y broses ddynodi, a'r asesiadau effaith cysylltiedig, rwyf wedi dod i farn dros dro ynghylch y cwestiwn a ddylid cadarnhau, cadarnhau gydag addasiadau neu wrthod y gorchymyn dynodi. Ar hyn o bryd rwy'n bwriadu peidio â chadarnhau'r Gorchymyn dynodi, ac o ganlyniad rwy'n bwriadu peidio â bwrw ymlaen ag ymchwiliad lleol cyhoeddus ar hyn o bryd. Bydd peidio â chadarnhau'r Gorchymyn dynodi a pheidio â bwrw ymlaen ag ymchwiliad lleol cyhoeddus yn golygu nad oes parc cenedlaethol newydd wedi'i sefydlu ar hyn o bryd.

Rwyf eisiau bod yn glir gyda'r Aelodau nad yw hwn yn benderfyniad terfynol. Cyn dod i benderfyniad terfynol, rwy'n bwriadu rhoi cyfle byr i bawb sydd â buddiant o ran y cynnig hwn wneud sylwadau pellach mewn perthynas â'r farn dros dro yr wyf wedi'i chyrraedd.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a’r Cyfansoddiad: Y camau nesaf ar gyfer Gorchymyn (Dynodi) Parc Cenedlaethol Glyndŵr
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Statement by the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution: The next steps for the Glyndŵr National Park (Designation) Order
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Bydd Aelodau'n cofio bod y weinyddiaeth flaenorol wedi gofyn i Gyfoeth Naturiol Cymru i asesu'r achos o blaid parc cenedlaethol newydd. Yn dilyn rhaglen drwyadl o gasglu tystiolaeth, trafod ac ymgynghori, daeth Cyfoeth Naturiol Cymru i'r casgliad bod ardal y parc cenedlaethol Glyndŵr arfaethedig yn bodloni'r profion statudol ar gyfer ei dynodi, a chyflwynodd Orchymyn dynodi i Weinidogion Cymru.

Ers hynny, mae llwyth o dystiolaeth wedi'i chasglu. Daeth dros 400 o ymatebion i law yn ystod y cyfnod hysbysu. Roedd y rhain yn adlewyrchu amrywiaeth o safbwyntiau, gyda llawer o ymatebwyr yn cefnogi a llawer yn gwrthwynebu. Cyflwynwyd gwrthwynebiadau sylweddol hefyd, gan gynnwys gwrthwynebiadau gan bob un o'r pum awdurdod lleol yn yr ardal berthnasol. Teimladau cryf o blaid a theimladau cryf yn erbyn. Mae llawer wedi tynnu sylw at y manteision posibl: cyfleoedd i adfer natur, gwrthsefyll newid hinsawdd yn well, rhoi arweiniad strategol ar gyfer rheoli'r dirwedd, cefnogi hamddena a thwristiaeth gynaliadwy. Mae'r dystiolaeth gan Gyfoeth Naturiol Cymru yn nodi nifer o gyfleoedd yn y meysydd hyn.

Ar yr un pryd, mae cwestiynau pwysig wedi'u codi ar hyd y broses yn ymwneud â fforddiadwyedd, gofynion cyllidol y dyfodol, gwerth am arian, trefniadau llywodraethu ac effeithiau posibl ar gymunedau lleol, seilwaith, datblygiadau ynni, tai a'r iaith Gymraeg. Mae'r pryderon yma wedi'u codi gan awdurdodau lleol a chynrychiolwyr y sectorau busnes a rheoli tir.

Wrth i fi ddod i gasgliad dros dro, dwi wedi ystyried y materion yma'n fanwl. Dwi wedi ystyried canlyniadau'r asesiad effaith rheoleiddiol a'r asesiad effaith integredig gafodd eu paratoi gan swyddogion. Mae'r dadansoddiad yn nodi manteision posibl ynghyd ag ansicrwydd sylweddol. Mae'r asesiad effaith rheoleiddiol yn amcangyfrif costau sefydlu o dros £11 miliwn ac yn nodi'r costau wedi hynny sy'n gysylltiedig â sefydlu a gweithredu awdurdod parc cenedlaethol newydd. Mae hefyd yn nodi ansicrwydd yn y sylfaen dystiolaeth.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Members will be aware that the previous administration asked Natural Resources Wales to assess the case for a new national park. Following an extensive programme of evidence gathering, engagement and consultation, NRW concluded that the area comprising the proposed Glyndŵr national park did meet the statutory tests for designation, and submitted the designation Order to Welsh Ministers.

Since then, a significant volume of evidence has been gathered. Over 400 responses were received during the notification period. These reflected a variety of views, with many respondents supporting the proposal and many opposing it. Significant objections were also submitted, including objections from every one of the five local authorities in the area. There were strong feelings in favour and strong feelings against. Many have highlighted the potential benefits: these include opportunities to enhance nature recovery, strengthen climate resilience, provide strategic leadership for landscape management, and support recreation and sustainable tourism. The evidence presented by NRW identifies a number of opportunities in these areas.

At the same time, important questions have been raised throughout the process relating to affordability, funding requirements in the future, value for money, governance arrangements and potential impacts on local communities, infrastructure, energy developments, housing and the Welsh language. These concerns have been raised by local authorities, businesses and land managers.

In reaching my provisional view, I have carefully considered these issues. I have considered the findings of the regulatory impact assessment and integrated impact assessment prepared by officials. That analysis highlights both possible benefits and significant uncertainties. The regulatory impact assessment estimates establishment costs of over £11 million and identifies ongoing costs associated with establishing and operating a new national park authority. It also notes uncertainty in the evidence base.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a’r Cyfansoddiad: Y camau nesaf ar gyfer Gorchymyn (Dynodi) Parc Cenedlaethol Glyndŵr
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Statement by the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution: The next steps for the Glyndŵr National Park (Designation) Order
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Fel dwi eisoes wedi'i nodi, gwnaeth y pum awdurdod lleol yn yr ardal wrthwynebu'r dynodiad. Er fy mod wedi ystyried yn ofalus yr holl sylwadau sydd wedi dod i law, dwi'n cydnabod ei bod yn bwysig iawn deall barn yr awdurdodau lleol yma, sydd eisoes yn chwarae rhan wrth gyflawni llawer o’r canlyniadau a geisir trwy ddynodi ac a fyddai’n bartneriaid pwysig pe bai parc cenedlaethol yn cael ei sefydlu yn y pen draw.

Dwi'n ystyried felly fod gwerth mawr mewn parhau i gadw ffocws cryf ar alluogi'r dynodiadau a'r partneriaethau presennol yma i gyflawni ar gyfer natur, hinsawdd, treftadaeth ddiwylliannol, hamdden a chymunedau lleol, tra'n parhau i fynd ar drywydd yr amcanion a nodwyd drwy broses ddynodi parc Glyndŵr drwy fecanweithiau eraill. Er enghraifft, rŷn ni'n cymryd camau ymarferol i adfer natur ac adeiladu gwydnwch hinsawdd ar draws y gogledd-ddwyrain. Drwy raglen genedlaethol mawndir Llywodraeth Cymru, cyflawnwyd gwaith adfer sylweddol o fewn tirwedd genedlaethol bryniau Clwyd a dyffryn Dyfrdwy, gan gynnwys safle rhostir Llandegla sydd o ddiddordeb gwyddonol arbennig, gan ddod â thua 120 hectar o fawndir i gyflwr gwell.

Mae'r dystiolaeth yn dangos bod llawer o'r heriau a nodwyd gan Gyfoeth Naturiol Cymru eisoes dan ystyriaeth gan raglenni presennol y Llywodraeth hon. Yn eu plith mae ein gwaith ar adfer bioamrywiaeth, adfer mawndiroedd, rhwydweithiau natur, y cynllun ffermio cynaliadwy, gan gynnwys Ffermio Bro, gweithredu ar hinsawdd a natur, twristiaeth gynaliadwy a buddsoddi ehangach yng nghefn gwlad.

Yn bwysig, mae'r polisïau yma eisoes yn cyflawni canlyniadau gwirioneddol i gymunedau, ffermwyr a'r amgylchedd. Mae Ffermio Bro, ein cynllun ffermio cynaliadwy pwrpasol ar gyfer tirweddau dynodedig, yn cefnogi ffermwyr i weithredu’n ymarferol ar gyfer adferiad natur, gwydnwch hinsawdd a rheoli tir cynaliadwy. Mae ffermwyr yn fferm Llangwyfan yn adfer gwrychoedd i ailgysylltu coetir hynafol a gwella rheoli coetiroedd i gryfhau cynefinoedd ar gyfer fflora a ffawna brodorol. Mae hyn yn helpu i greu tirwedd fwy cysylltiedig a gwydn. Mae'n ymddangos i mi, felly, y gellir cyflawni'r amcanion a gafodd eu nodi gan y broses ddynodi trwy fecanweithiau amgen, heb sefydlu awdurdod parc cenedlaethol newydd a heb ysgwyddo'r ymrwymiadau ariannol y byddai ar y dynodiad eu hangen wedi hynny.

Wrth edrych ymlaen, dwi'n credu bydd yna gyfleoedd pellach i sicrhau'r canlyniadau hyn drwy waith y Llywodraeth, drwy ein cynllun gweithredu hinsawdd a natur sydd ar ein gweill, ein strategaeth ddiwylliant, ein dyletswydd diogelu gwledig a chynaliadwyedd amgylcheddol arfaethedig, a fydd yn cryfhau'r ystyriaeth o gynaliadwyedd amgylcheddol, gwydnwch hinsawdd ac effeithiau gwledig ar draws penderfyniadau'r sector cyhoeddus. Dwi hefyd am ystyried a ellir cryfhau'r trefniadau presennol ar gyfer tirweddau cenedlaethol, ochr yn ochr â dulliau integredig eraill sy'n cefnogi adferiad natur, rheoli tir cynaliadwy a chymunedau gwledig ffyniannus.

Wedi dweud hynny i gyd, dwi'n cydnabod arwyddocâd y cynnig hwn sydd o'n blaenau heddiw a'r diddordeb mawr sydd ynddo. Fy nghyfrifoldeb i yw dod i gasgliad rhesymol ar sail yr holl wybodaeth berthnasol. Am y rheswm hwnnw, dwi ddim am wneud penderfyniad terfynol heddiw. Yn hytrach, dwi’n gwahodd unrhyw barti i gyflwyno sylwadau pellach cyn inni wneud penderfyniad terfynol.

Dyma gyfle felly i awdurdodau lleol, sefydliadau cynrychioladol, busnesau, grwpiau cymunedol ac aelodau o'r cyhoedd gyflwyno unrhyw dystiolaeth, dadleuon neu ystyriaethau materol ychwanegol y credant y dylai Gweinidogion Cymru eu hystyried. Gall pobl a sefydliadau gyflwyno'u barn drwy e-bost neu drwy'r post, a bydd y manylion ar wefan Llywodraeth Cymru wrth i ni ddod i ddiwedd y datganiad hwn yn y Senedd heddiw. Byddaf hefyd yn cyhoeddi dolenni i ystod o'r dystiolaeth sydd wedi'i ddatblygu yn ystod y broses hyd yma i lywio'r ystyriaethau ymhellach. Byddwn i'n annog pobl i gyflwyno sylwadau yn benodol sy'n darparu tystiolaeth neu wybodaeth newydd nad ydynt eisoes wedi eu hystyried drwy'r gwaith helaeth a wnaed hyd yn hyn.

Nid bwriad y camau hyn yw ailadrodd ymarferion ymgynghori cynharach; yn hytrach, mae'n bwriadu sicrhau bod yr holl dystiolaeth berthnasol wedi ei hystyried yn briodol ac yn rhesymol cyn gwneud penderfyniad terfynol. Ar ôl i'r cyfnod hwn ddod i ben, mewn pedair wythnos, bydd swyddogion yn dadansoddi'r sylwadau a dderbyniwyd ac yn rhoi cyngor pellach i mi. Yna byddaf yn ystyried yr holl gyflwyniadau yn ofalus cyn dod i benderfyniad terfynol, ynghyd â chyhoeddi fy rhesymau.

Mae tirweddau cymunedau a threftadaeth ddiwylliannol y gogledd-ddwyrain yn bwysig yn genedlaethol. Beth bynnag yw'r canlyniad terfynol, mae'r dystiolaeth a gasglwyd dros y blynyddoedd diwethaf wedi tynnu sylw at eu rhinweddau arbennig a'r heriau maen nhw'n eu hwynebu. Dwi'n parhau i ymrwymo i weithio gyda phartneriaid i sicrhau canlyniadau cadarnhaol i'r tirweddau, i'r cymunedau a chenedlaethau'r dyfodol. Nodwch eto: mae'r cyhoeddiad hwn yn cynrychioli barn dros dro yn unig. Dwi'n annog pawb sydd â diddordeb i ymgysylltu'n adeiladol ar y camau nesaf, fel bod unrhyw benderfyniad terfynol yn cael ei lywio gan yr ystyriaeth lawnaf bosib o'r dystiolaeth sydd o'n blaenau. Diolch yn fawr.
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
As I have already noted, all five local authorities in the area objected to the designation. While I have carefully considered all representations received, I do recognise the importance of understanding the views of these local authorities, which already play a role in delivering many of the outcomes that are sought through designation and which would be important partners should a national park ultimately be established.

I therefore consider that there is great value in continuing to maintain a strong focus on enabling those existing designations and partnerships to deliver for nature, climate, cultural heritage, recreation and local communities, while continuing to pursue the objectives identified through the Glyndŵr park designation process through other mechanisms. For example, we are taking practical action to restore nature and build climate resilience across the north-east. Through the Welsh Government’s national peatland programme, significant restoration work has been delivered within the Clwydian range and Dee valley national landscape, including at Llandegla moor site, which is of special scientific interest, bringing around 120 hectares of peatland into a more favourable condition.

The evidence demonstrates that many of the challenges identified by Natural Resources Wales are already being addressed through this Welsh Government's current programmes. These include our work on biodiversity recovery, peatland restoration, nature networks, the sustainable farming scheme, including Ffermio Bro, climate and nature action, sustainable tourism and wider rural investment.

Importantly, these policies are already delivering real outcomes for communities, farmers and the environment. Ffermio Bro, our bespoke sustainable farming scheme for designated landscapes, is supporting farmers to deliver practical action for nature recovery, climate resilience and sustainable land management. Farmers at Llangwyfan farm are restoring hedgerows to reconnect ancient woodland and improve woodland management to strengthen habitats for native flora and fauna. This is helping to create a more connected and resilient landscape. It therefore appears to me that the objectives identified through the designation process may be delivered through alternative mechanisms, without establishing a new national park authority and without incurring the ongoing financial commitments that the designation would require.

Looking ahead, I believe there will be further opportunities to secure these outcomes through the Welsh Government's work, through our climate and nature action plan, our culture strategy, our proposed rural-proofing and environmental sustainability duty, which will strengthen the consideration of environmental sustainability, climate resilience and rural impacts across public sector decision making. I will also consider whether existing arrangements for national landscapes can be further strengthened, alongside other integrated approaches that support nature recovery, sustainable land management and thriving rural communities.

Having said all that, I do recognise the significance of this proposal in front of us today and the strong interest it continues to generate. My responsibility is to reach a reasonable conclusion on the basis of all the relevant information. It's for that reason that I am not making a final decision today. Instead, I invite any party to submit further representations before reaching a final decision.

This is therefore an opportunity for local authorities, representative organisations, businesses, community groups and members of the public to present any additional evidence, arguments or material considerations that they believe Welsh Ministers should take into account. People and organisations can submit their views via e-mail or through the post, the details of which will be on the Welsh Government's website as we bring the statement in the Senedd today to a close. I will also be publishing links to a range of evidence that has been developed during the process so far to further inform these considerations. I would encourage people to provide new evidence, in particular, or information that has not already been considered through the extensive work carried out to date.

The intention of these steps is not to repeat earlier consultation exercises; rather, it is intended to ensure that all relevant evidence has been properly considered and in a reasonable manner before a final decision is made. Once this period has concluded, in four weeks' time, officials will analyse the representations received and provide further advice to me. Then I will consider all submissions carefully before coming to a final decision, as well as publishing my reasons.

The landscapes, communities and cultural heritage of the north-east are nationally important. Whatever the final outcome, the evidence assembled over recent years has highlighted both their special qualities and the challenges they face. I remain committed to working with partners to secure positive outcomes for those landscapes, communities and future generations. Note again that this announcement represents a provisional view only. I encourage all interested parties to engage constructively with the next steps so that any final decision is informed by the fullest possible consideration of the evidence before us. Thank you very much.

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_welsh: 3. Datganiad gan y Gweinidog Cabinet dros Effeithiolrwydd Llywodraeth a’r Cyfansoddiad: Y camau nesaf ar gyfer Gorchymyn (Dynodi) Parc Cenedlaethol Glyndŵr
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.Agenda_item_english: 3. Statement by the Cabinet Minister for Government Effectiveness and the Constitution: The next steps for the Glyndŵr National Park (Designation) Order
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim:
Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. Cabinet Minister, we've only known each other for a few months, but during that time I've found you to be a reasonable man, and quite frankly, we have political differences, but I know that, as I do, you have the best interests of the people of Wales. So, as such, your statement on a proposed new national park for Wales is welcome. In this instance, nobody in this Chamber needs convincing that the Clwydian range, the Dee valley and the wider area covered by the proposal contain some of the finest landscapes in Wales; they're absolutely fantastic. However, that is not the issue; the issue is determining whether a new national park with associated new powers and costs is the right answer. 

Cabinet Minister, I applaud your recognition that there remain too many unanswered questions to confirm the designation Order or to conduct a public inquiry at the moment. We know that Natural Resources Wales believes the area meets the statutory test for designation. However, we also know that serious concerns remain. Numerous opposition points have been raised by stakeholders. Denbighshire has maintained its objection. Flintshire has raised concerns surrounding costs, duplication of planning, amongst others. These concerns matter because this isn't simply about drawing a line on a map, is it? People live within these lines. They farm, they run businesses, they raise families, and basically they're entitled to know what this proposal will actually mean for their lives and livelihoods. That's paramount. They deserve absolute transparency.

So, Cabinet Minister, I appreciate your commitment to pausing proposals in light of the continued uncertainty. Your recognition of the affordability question and what makes commercial common sense for Wales is welcome. These proposals intersect with Wales's best financial interests and the heart of Welsh communities. The important question now is what will happen afterwards or to these proposals.

You've made it clear that your statement today is not a final decision, and have committed to giving an opportunity to those with an interest in these proposals to make further representations. But after the four weeks' extended consultation period, what will happen next? You have committed to ensuring officials will analyse the representations and provide further advice; however, the representations of the interested parties must be listened to—not simply heard, but listened to. Because if local government, communities and other interested parties are to feel confident in the proposals, they must be confident that their views have been listened to and are capable of influencing the final decision.

When looking at the area in question, it's clear that statistics on tourist footfall are positive. In the 2025 statutory consultation report, Natural Resources Wales found that the area already draws 3.3 million visitors annually. Cabinet Minister, it is the right decision not to push forward with the proposals with an incomplete evidence base when it cannot be guaranteed that councils such as Denbighshire, Flintshire, Wrexham and others will not end up carrying additional costs, whether directly or indirectly.

Then there's the effect on local communities, of course. A national park is not simply scenery. There are legitimate concerns about housing development, tourism, traffic and the ability of younger people to remain in the communities where they grew up, with implications for the Welsh language, of course. These concerns should not be dismissed as hostility to environmental protection. They are practical questions about how this proposal will work in the real world.

And finally, Cabinet Minister, there is a question of trust, isn't there? The law provides for objections to be heard for a jolly good reason. Affected county councils and communities have already raised serious issues. Basically, they need to discuss these matters further. I applaud your commitment to exploring how the objectives of the designating process can be delivered under alternative arrangements, and without the £11.6 million estimated establishment cost. We need to understand the fundamentals before prioritising designation: what issues does a new national park solve, why is this particular structure the right solution, how will it work, how will it be funded, and who will be accountable when decisions go wrong.

Cabinet Minister, in light of persistent unanswered questions, the decision not to pursue these proposals before further representations are made across the board is absolutely the right one. Should your Government answer these questions in the affirmative and make a clear financial and local case for proposals, we in Reform will look positively upon the proposals and we will support it, but only if it reflects the wishes of the people of the communities most directly affected. Before another layer of Government is created in north-east Wales, those questions deserve clear answers. The purpose of this Chamber is to represent the interests of the Welsh people—
XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_translated:
Diolch, Ddirprwy Lywydd. Weinidog Cabinet, dim ond ers ychydig fisoedd yr ydym wedi adnabod ein gilydd, ond yn ystod y cyfnod hwnnw rydw i wedi gweld eich bod chi'n ddyn rhesymol, ac yn hollol onest, mae gennym wahaniaethau gwleidyddol, ond rwy'n gwybod eich bod yn ystyried buddiannau gorau pobl Cymru. Felly mae croeso i'ch datganiad ar barc cenedlaethol newydd arfaethedig i Gymru. Yn yr achos hwn, does neb yn y Siambr hon angen ei argyhoeddi bod bryniau Clwyd, dyffryn Dyfrdwy a'r ardal ehangach a gwmpesir gan y cynnig yn cynnwys rhai o'r tirweddau gorau yng Nghymru; maen nhw'n hollol wych. Fodd bynnag, nid dyna'r mater; y mater yw penderfynu ai parc cenedlaethol newydd gyda phwerau a chostau newydd cysylltiedig yw'r ateb cywir.

Weinidog Cabinet, rwy'n cymeradwyo eich cydnabyddiaeth bod gormod o gwestiynau heb eu hateb i gadarnhau'r Gorchymyn dynodi neu i gynnal ymchwiliad cyhoeddus ar hyn o bryd. Gwyddom fod Cyfoeth Naturiol Cymru yn credu bod yr ardal yn bodloni'r prawf statudol ar gyfer dynodi. Fodd bynnag, gwyddom hefyd fod pryderon difrifol yn parhau. Mae nifer o bwyntiau sy'n gwrthwynebu wedi'u codi gan randdeiliaid. Mae sir Ddinbych wedi cadw at ei gwrthwynebiad. Mae sir y Fflint wedi codi pryderon ynglŷn â chostau, dyblygu cynllunio, ymhlith eraill. Mae'r pryderon hyn yn bwysig oherwydd nid yw hyn yn ymwneud â thynnu llinell ar fap yn unig, nac ydyw? Mae pobl yn byw o fewn y llinellau hyn. Maen nhw'n ffermio, maen nhw'n rhedeg busnesau, maen nhw'n magu teuluoedd, ac yn y bôn mae ganddyn nhw hawl i wybod beth fydd y cynnig hwn yn ei olygu i'w bywydau a'u bywoliaethau. Mae hynny'n hollbwysig. Maent yn haeddu tryloywder llwyr.

Felly, Weinidog Cabinet, rwy'n gwerthfawrogi eich ymrwymiad i oedi cynigion yng ngoleuni'r ansicrwydd parhaus. Croesewir eich cydnabyddiaeth o'r cwestiwn fforddiadwyedd a'r hyn sy'n gwneud synnwyr cyffredin masnachol i Gymru. Mae'r cynigion hyn yn croestorri â buddiannau ariannol gorau Cymru a chalon cymunedau Cymru. Y cwestiwn pwysig nawr yw beth fydd yn digwydd wedyn neu i'r cynigion hyn.

Rydych wedi ei gwneud yn glir nad yw eich datganiad heddiw yn benderfyniad terfynol, ac wedi ymrwymo i roi cyfle i'r rhai sydd â buddiant o ran y cynigion hyn wneud sylwadau pellach. Ond ar ôl y cyfnod ymgynghori estynedig o bedair wythnos, beth fydd yn digwydd nesaf? Rydych wedi ymrwymo i sicrhau y bydd swyddogion yn dadansoddi'r sylwadau ac yn darparu cyngor pellach; fodd bynnag, rhaid gwrando ar sylwadau'r partïon â buddiant—nid yn unig eu clywed, ond gwrando arnynt. Oherwydd os yw llywodraeth leol, cymunedau a phartïon eraill â buddiant i deimlo'n hyderus o ran y cynigion, rhaid iddynt fod yn hyderus y gwrandewir ar eu barn ac y gallant ddylanwadu ar y penderfyniad terfynol.

Wrth edrych ar yr ardal dan sylw, mae'n amlwg bod ystadegau ar dwristiaid yn gadarnhaol. Yn adroddiad ymgynghori statudol 2025, canfu Cyfoeth Naturiol Cymru fod yr ardal eisoes yn denu 3.3 miliwn o ymwelwyr bob blwyddyn. Weinidog Cabinet, mae'n benderfyniad cywir i beidio â bwrw ymlaen â'r cynigion gyda sylfaen dystiolaeth anghyflawn pan na ellir gwarantu na fydd cynghorau fel sir Ddinbych, sir y Fflint, Wrecsam ac eraill yn y pen draw yn ysgwyddo costau ychwanegol, boed yn uniongyrchol neu'n anuniongyrchol.

Yna mae'r effaith ar gymunedau lleol, wrth gwrs. Nid golygfeydd yn unig yw parc cenedlaethol. Mae pryderon cyfiawn ynglŷn â datblygu tai, twristiaeth, traffig a gallu pobl ifanc i aros yn y cymunedau lle cawsant eu magu, gyda goblygiadau i'r Gymraeg, wrth gwrs. Ni ddylid diystyru'r pryderon hyn fel pethau gelyniaethus o ran diogelu'r amgylchedd. Maen nhw'n gwestiynau ymarferol ynglŷn â sut y bydd y cynnig hwn yn gweithio yn y byd go iawn.

Ac yn olaf, Weinidog Cabinet, mae yna gwestiwn o ymddiriedaeth, onid oes? Mae'r gyfraith yn darparu ar gyfer clywed gwrthwynebiadau am reswm da iawn. Mae cynghorau sir a chymunedau yr effeithir arnynt eisoes wedi codi materion difrifol. Yn y bôn, mae angen iddynt drafod y materion hyn ymhellach. Cymeradwyaf eich ymrwymiad i archwilio sut y gellir cyflawni amcanion y broses ddynodi o dan drefniadau amgen, a heb y gost sefydlu amcangyfrifedig o £11.6 miliwn. Mae angen i ni ddeall y pethau sylfaenol cyn blaenoriaethu dynodiad: pa broblemau y mae parc cenedlaethol newydd yn eu datrys, pam mai'r strwythur penodol hwn yw'r ateb cywir, sut y bydd yn gweithio, sut y bydd yn cael ei ariannu, a phwy fydd yn atebol pan fydd penderfyniadau'n mynd o chwith.

Weinidog Cabinet, yng ngoleuni cwestiynau parhaus heb eu hateb, mae'r penderfyniad i beidio â mynd ar drywydd y cynigion hyn cyn i sylwadau pellach gael eu gwneud ar draws y bwrdd yn hollol gywir. Os bydd eich Llywodraeth yn ateb y cwestiynau hyn yn gadarnhaol ac yn gwneud achos ariannol a lleol clir dros gynigion, byddwn ni yn Reform yn edrych yn gadarnhaol ar y cynigion a byddwn yn ei gefnogi, ond dim ond os yw'n adlewyrchu dymuniadau pobl y cymunedau yr effeithir arnynt fwyaf uniongyrchol. Cyn creu haen arall o Lywodraeth yn y gogledd-ddwyrain, mae'r cwestiynau hynny'n haeddu atebion clir. Pwrpas y Siambr hon yw cynrychioli buddiannau pobl Cymru—

XML_Plenary_Bilingual.contribution_verbatim: Thank you to the opposition spokesperson for his comments. My intention, Dirprwy Lywydd, is not to get into immense detail in my responses, because we are now in a phase of listening.
